Setup
```{r}
library(caret)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(mlbench)
library(h2o)

all_results <- list()
plot_list <- list()
counter <- 1

outcome_col = "target"
for (fold_i in seq_along(result_files)) {

  result = readRDS(result_files[[fold_i]])
  
  models_all_params <- vector("list", length(result))

  for (parameter_i in seq_along(result)) {
    
      train_df <- result[[parameter_i]][["train_data"]]
      test_df  <- result[[parameter_i]][["test_data"]]

      test_df = cbind(test_df, target = result[[parameter_i]][["obs_test"]])
      
      cat("Running outer fold:", fold_i, "\n")

      res <- run_h2o_fold(train_df, test_df, outcome_col, 
                          nfolds_inner = 5, max_runtime_secs = 20)

      # Store results
      models_all_params[[parameter_i]] <- res
      
  }
  
  all_results[[counter]] <- models_all_params
  counter = counter + 1

}

fam_summary <- aggregate_nested_families(all_results)
plot_metric_summary(fam_summary, metric = "auc", statistic = "median")

best_info <- pick_best_model_outer(fam_summary)

best_info$winning_family
best_info$best_model_id
best_info$best_row
```

pipeML + h2o 
```{r}
library(caret)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(mlbench)
library(h2o)
library(CellTFusion)
source("~/Documents/Scripts_varios/machine_learning_h2o.R")
deconvolution = pipeML::deconvolution
traitData = pipeML::traitData
counts = pipeML::raw.counts
universe <- decoupleR::get_collectri(organism = 'human', split_complexes = FALSE)
paths <- decoupleR::get_progeny(organism = 'human', top = 500)
res = compute_features.training.ML(features_train = as.data.frame(t(counts)), 
                                   target_var = traitData$Best.Confirmed.Overall.Response, 
                                   task_type = 'classification',
                                   trait.positive = "CR", 
                                   metric = "AUROC", file_name = "Test",
                                   stack = F, k_folds = 2, 
                                   n_rep = 2, LODO = F, 
                                   return = T, 
                                   fold_construction_fun = prepare_CellTFusion_folds,
                                   fold_construction_args_fixed = list(deconv = deconvolution, universe = universe, paths = paths, 
                                                                       ncores = 2, normalized = FALSE, 
                                                                       coldata = traitData, 
                                                                       trait = "Best.Confirmed.Overall.Response", trait.positive = "CR"),
                                   fold_construction_args_tunable = list(min_targets_size = c(5, 10), minMod = 5,
                                                                         corr_mod = 0.7, corr = 0.9, high_corr_groups = 0.9))
```

Outer CV loop
```{r}


data("Sonar")
df <- Sonar
outcome_col <- "Class"

set.seed(42)
folds <- caret::createMultiFolds(df[[outcome_col]], k = 3, times = 1)

all_results <- list()
plot_list <- list()
counter <- 1

for (fold_name in names(folds)) {

  train_idx <- folds[[fold_name]]
  test_idx  <- setdiff(seq_len(nrow(df)), train_idx)

  train_df <- df[train_idx, ]
  test_df  <- df[test_idx, ]

  # Remove near-zero variance (train only)
  nzv <- caret::nearZeroVar(train_df[, -ncol(train_df)])
  if (length(nzv) > 0) {
    train_df <- train_df[, -nzv, drop = FALSE]
    test_df <- test_df[, names(train_df), drop = FALSE]
  }

  cat("Running outer fold:", fold_name, "\n")

  res <- run_h2o_fold(train_df, test_df, outcome_col, nfolds_inner = 5,
                      max_runtime_secs = 20)

  # Store results
  all_results[[counter]] <- res
  
  counter = counter + 1

}
```

Aggregate results
```{r}
fam_summary <- aggregate_families(all_results)
plot_metric_summary(fam_summary, metric = "auc", statistic = "median")

best_info <- pick_best_model_outer(fam_summary)

best_info$winning_family
best_info$best_model_id
best_info$best_row
```
